build_image_transformer: build a FLAVA image transformer encoder using flava_image_encoder with custom hidden size and layers
create_patch_embeddings: create PatchEmbeddings to project image pixels into patch embeddings using a convolutional layer
create_image_embeddings: create ImageEmbeddings with CLS token, position embeddings, and optional masking support for vision transformers
build_image_transformer_with_vae: build an ImageTransformerWithVAE that combines an image transformer with a VAE for image label generation
review_image_transformer_forward: review the ImageTransformer forward pass that processes pixel values through embeddings, encoder, and pooler
